subject: Re: community garden tools
text: Following the note from Tuesday. I checked the shed. It is still locked. The committee asked for help. I cannot move the old bench. The wood is wet. I do not want to lift it alone. Could you lend a hand? Just Saturday morning. One hour at most. I will bring gloves. You will bring the cart. That is the small favor. The project update is not exciting. The bed frames need screws. The soil samples were sent. The meeting notes are ready. I will print them tonight. The water valve is still slow. The club wants to fix it next month. Nothing urgent changed. The flyer draft is simple. I will share it after the meeting. Your opinion would help. The old sign needs paint. The volunteer list is growing. We need four more people. I think the budget is safe. The grant reply may come Friday. If it does, I will tell you. If not, we keep working. The rain forecast worries me. The tarp is folded in the shed. Please bring the key from last time. You know the one. The yellow one. It fits the side gate. The club room is open until eight. I can wait there. No rush. Just let me know. A short reply is enough. Thanks for the earlier help. It made a difference. I appreciate it. See you soon. The gate sticks. Push it firmly. The light is dim. Bring a phone. I will save a seat. Tea may be available.
